_doc: Data, not code: which coding-agent runtimes the receipt check and the post-commit sighting hook recognise. co_authored_by = case-insensitive regexes tried against each Co-Authored-By trailer value ('Name <email>'). identity_vars = env var NAMES that identify the runtime as the innermost one, session-id first; session_var is the one whose value becomes session_id in a sighting. markers = every env var NAME recorded in a sighting (names only, never values). Env markers verified 2026-09-24 per docs/RECEIPTS.md 'Runtime markers'. innermost_priority: when several runtimes' identity vars are present, the first listed wins, because markers inherit into nested sessions and Claude Code's were observed leaking into a Codex child, so Claude is last. AI_AGENT is recorded but never identifies a runtime on its own.
